label: Exact deletion test for a bypass of nonintrinsic bearer esse (inference)
rule: Delete every group producing bearer esse and transport any bypassing derivation through that deletion
meaning: The special deletion cuts the nonintrinsic bearer index by last-step inversion. Conversely a surviving derivation after an arbitrary cut that removes esse cannot use a last group producing esse at any node. Induction transports it to the special deletion, a contradiction. The equivalence is a theorem of the stipulated restriction semantics.
